test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The population of a village was 1,20,000. It increased by 10% in the first year and increased by 30% in the second year. Its population after two years is _______.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the **successive percentage increase** formula for two years.

Net Percentage Increase = a + b + (a × b)/100 = 10 + 30 + (10 × 30)/100 = 43%.

Final Population = 120000 × 1.43 = 1,71,600.

**∴ The correct answer is 1,71,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Initial population = 1,20,000; Increase in 1st year = 10%; Increase in 2ⁿd year = 30%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d696a1389270a871c623549314478ae842cd531d94650cf3d404087be1ed4ac.png] 

**Formula:** Final Value = Initial Value × (1 + r₁/100) × (1 + r₂/100)

⇒ Population after 1st year = 1,20,000 + 10% of 1,20,000

⇒ Population after 1st year = 1,20,000 + 12,000 = 1,32,000

⇒ Population after 2ⁿd year = 1,32,000 + 30% of 1,32,000

⇒ Population after 2ⁿd year = 1,32,000 + 39,600

⇒ Population after 2ⁿd year = 1,71,600

**∴ The correct answer is 1,71,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Formula

When a value changes by a% then b%, the net change is (a + b + ab/100)%.

Multiplying Factor Method

An increase of x% is equivalent to multiplying by (1 + x/100). For 10%, multiply by 1.1; for 30%, multiply by 1.3.

Population Decrease

If the population decreases, use a negative sign in the formula: Final = Initial × (1 − r/100)ⁿ.</p
